name: Hollow Knell Archer
loreTies: A long-limbed Hollow marksman grown from remembered executions; every arrow is a moment someone forgot to duck.
Targets Endurance and Conduit Deities from cover, forcing movement.
Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
shortBackstory: Hollow Knell Archer is a Hollow threat creature built for campaign and event encounters, turning erased memory into minor battlefield pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hollow Knell Archer formed where the Hollow learned a specific weakness in remembered civilization. It is not a Deity, not a citizen, and not a recruitable unit; it is a symptom of the Gate giving absence a body.

chapters.title: Hollow Function
chapters.text: Its role inside the Hollow threat faction is precise: Targets Endurance and Conduit Deities from cover, forcing movement. This lets mission designers select it by encounter tags instead of treating Hollow enemies as one shapeless swarm.

chapters.title: Lore Tie
chapters.text: A long-limbed Hollow marksman grown from remembered executions; every arrow is a moment someone forgot to duck.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: Hollow Knell Archer can appear in Normal missions, Elite remixes, Hollow Breach events, Ascension floors, and raid add waves when its tags match the objective pressure. It must always reinforce Hollowing: isolation, corrupted memory, broken objectives, or stolen meaning.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Art and gameplay must keep Hollow Knell Archer visibly non-playable. Its silhouette uses tall charcoal archer with broken crescent bow, mask slit, pale arrow-sparks, ragged funeral cloth. while its abilities — Knell Shot, Backline Mark — create battlefield pressure without confusing it for a faction Deity.

developmentStatus: Readable Hollow creature profile integrated into campaign/event threat pages.
